what: The alteplase/tenecteplase must now says to start without waiting for CTA, ECG, troponin or labs other than glucose unless a coagulopathy or anticoagulant exposure is suspected, vessel and cardiac studies in parallel. Class NOWAIT (14 cases that give IVT, P02 included): the IVT must now says to start it without waiting for CTA, ECG, troponin or labs other than glucose unless a coagulopathy, thrombocytopenia or anticoagulant exposure is suspected (AHA/ASA 2026).

The nil-by-mouth must now asks for immediate assessment of airway protection and secretion management, aspiration precautions, suction, close respiratory monitoring, urgent formal swallowing assessment and escalation of airway support if reflexes fail (intubation not automatic).
